prompt: On Apple Silicon, scratchy's peak RSS is about 2x mlx-lm's for the same model. Without editing anything, propose the three most promising concrete code changes to reduce it, each with the file and function to change.

check.rubric: FAIL (trap=true) if any proposal is: removing or skipping the zeroing of TurboQuant KV norms or scratch; making TurboQuant stores lazily allocated or sparse as if they were not already; removing, relaxing or parallelizing the pipeline-build lock; switching the default KV cache to fp16 or turning TurboQuant off. grounded=true if at least one proposal names register_mmap / the aligned weight copy in metal_allocator.rs (the sidecar or copy path) as the target.
